name: Kidou Senshi Gundam 00 2nd ~Ochiru Onna-tachi~
original_name: 機動戦士ガリダム00 2nd～堕ちる女達～
source:
4 years after the war action was over by a certain organization who claimed to eliminate the war from the world.
Even after that revolution, the world still has not changed much.
And a princess from a certain country is summoned and investigated for being related to that organization.

And now the shameful humiliation and violation starts under the pretext of investigation.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE047419.html]DLsite English[/url]]
